haley.docs: Heads-up  I'm about to open a focused PR to harmonize our function/tool-calling + structured-output docs. Goal: one canonical invoice and user_intent example, a compact schema-pointer envelope for edge/mobile, a brief guardrails checklist, and two link fixes. Will open the first commit in ~30m.

samir.eng: Nice. Quick Q: do we want the compact envelope to use `schema_ref` or `schema_ptr`? I prefer `schema_ref` (matches tooling). I can run the parser harness once examples land.

haley.docs: Going with `schema_ref`. Plan: move canonical JSONs to /docs/schemas/{invoice,user_intent}.json, show full-envelope + compact `schema_ref` variants, add a tiny consumer-test snippet for CI (validate -> partial-parse -> fallback-to-text), and fix parsing pattern anchors that moved.

anna-devex: I'll convert SDK snippets (TS + Python) to the new `structured_output` param shape. Compact example I want to add:
```json
{"tool_call":{"name":"fetch_invoice","arguments":{"id":"INV-2322"}}, "structured_output":{"schema_ref":"/docs/schemas/invoice.json"}}
```

mike-rls: Add a short streaming note too: show how partial tool-call chunks should annotate `chunk_index` and `final_chunk: true` so consumers can re-assemble. Also include a tiny CI consumer test showing validator fallback if schema validation fails.

samir.eng: FYI runtime behavior: numbers are normalized (no trailing .0), single-item arrays can collapse unless `minItems:1`. I'll run a batch of prompts and paste observed outputs so the examples reflect reality.

haley.docs: Please add any diffs as "Observed vs expected" bullets in the PR. We'll keep a compact envelope example for low-bandwidth clients and a full-inline-schema example for readers who want everything on one page.

anna-devex: Also adding telemetry guidance: tag canonical examples with `example:canonical-v1` in our sample metadata so we can detect drift in evals. Small snippet will show where to add that metadata.

mike-rls: For the guardrails box, recommend a short policy: 1) validate against schema; 2) if validation fails, attempt partial parse keeping present fields; 3) log and emit raw text fallback. Include a short code snippet for the consumer test harness.

haley.docs: Lint command for reviewers: `make docs-lint && ./tools/verify-snippets --path docs/structured-output`. Add a one-liner to run the parser harness: `./dev/tools/parse-check --schema docs/schemas/invoice.json --prompts examples/invoice_prompts.txt`.

samir.eng: I'll attach harness outputs here. If the parser trims decimals or collapses arrays we should show a tiny "Observed vs expected" list so readers know why sample outputs look different.

anna-devex: Also adding a "gotchas" micro-list: avoid ambiguous `oneOf` where possible, be explicit with `nullable` arrays, and prefer `minItems` for arrays you expect to preserve. Will include examples of each.

mike-rls: After merge I'll canary the docs site and check snippet rendering (compact inline vs schema_ref). If layout breaks for mobile we'll tweak formatting in a follow-up.

docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5150 by haley.docs

haley.docs: Assigning reviewers @anna-devex and @samir.eng. Target merge: Fri EOD if CI + lint pass. I'll push the first commit shortly and ping when PR is updated.
